question: Should Gitcrawl accept this v5 sync_attempt_failures schema and the gitcrawl sync-failures plus coverage JSON semantics as the supported failed-hydration tracking contract?
rationale: The implementation is coherent and proof-backed, but it freezes persisted SQLite fields and agent-facing output that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Accept after coverage repair
options.body: Require the small coverage fix, then merge if the schema fields, retry/resolved behavior, and JSON output are the desired contract.

options.title: Narrow the public contract
options.body: Ask the contributor to reduce, rename, or mark the JSON surface experimental before merge if maintainers want more flexibility.

options.title: Pause for a different ledger shape
options.body: Keep https://github.com/openclaw/gitcrawl/issues/84 open and request a redesign if the table uniqueness, error classification, or resolution semantics are not the desired direction.

recommendation.title: Accept after coverage repair
recommendation.body: Require the small coverage fix, then merge if the schema fields, retry/resolved behavior, and JSON output are the desired contract.

likelyOwner.reason: They completed and landed the current coverage command with the explicit failure-ledger handoff, making them the clearest owner for the contract decision.
